1) Knife removal & rotation
- Remove feed works guard assembly, then remove 4 bolts holding feed works in place
- Begin swinging the feed works open. The chain connecting the feed works to the gear reducer can be slipped off once of the sprockets.
- Pivot feed works assembly clear. Remove the infeed material guide by removing 4 button head screws. Both knifes can be accessed through opening in front housing, you may have to rotate flywheel by hand to bring knife to access hole.
- Remove bolts securing knifes. If there is a shim in knife pocket, leave in place when rotating knife edge.
- Clean knife pockets thoroughly and move any burrs on the used knife edge to assure it is set properly.
- Replace knife in pocket and lightly tighten bolts. Seat knife by tapping it with brass hammer.
-Finish tightening the bolts with a torque wrench (60 ft-lb)

1) Wipe off cabinet and blow off inside with low pressure air. Be careful not to damage any internal components or circuits.
2) Detector line should be activated by flashing light, make sure the fire LED & buzzer alerts.

Detectors
1) Remove cover & inspect detectors to ensure that they are free of dust and moisture. If any dust is present blow out with low pressure and dry out ant moisture completely. 
2) Entry point should be found and sealed with caulking. 
3) Inspect detector lenses and clean if there is buildup of material. Lens should have a shiny black appearance with no cracks or chips.
4) Each detector should be tested for proper operation. This is done by exposing them to sunlight or a flashlight directly in front of lens. Detector should activate properly each time.

Extinguishing Device
1) The strainer on each should be removed and inspected, any build up should be cleaned off.
2) While testing, assembly should be activated so water is sprayed at least once. Be sure to hat switch is returned to normal condition after completion of test.
